title: Orange Beach Dolphin & Sunset Cruises @ The Wharf Aboard Sunny Lady
breadcrumbs: Orange Beach Dolphin & Sunset Cruises @ The Wharf Aboard Sunny Lady
description: The Sunny Lady runs Dolphin Cruises daily. Family owned and operated, this is an ideal way to enjoy a relaxing 1.5-2 hour cruise watching dolphins play in their natural habitat. These boats feature a snack bar, restrooms and an air conditioned and heated cabin.

reviews.author: John W Kelly
reviews.text: We saw plenty of dolphins and the crew was great.

reviews.author: Ashley Gertz
reviews.text: My family had the best time on this dolphin cruise! The captain and team were so entertaining! They even had a big live parrot on board! We did get to see dolphins swimming around us! It was great! Also, lots of seagulls chasing our boat and kids loved this part so much!! Best time ever!

reviews.author: Andrika Wyatt
reviews.text: Very fun, kid friendly and even gave kids Cheetos to feed the birds

reviews.author: Keyunna Black
reviews.text: This was simply amazing! Everyone was friendly and kindhearted! The weather was definitely perfect

reviews.author: Jeremy Higgins
reviews.text: Was a little skeptical with it being in the bay. But turned out to be the best dolphin cruise we've been on.

reviews.author: Sally Moore
reviews.text: Captain and crew were amazing. Plenty of dolphins. Weather was beautiful. Couldn't ask for a better day

reviews.author: Marc OBrien
reviews.text: Both captains very knowledgeable, they provide food to feed the birds. The dolphins really put on a show. We even had 2 mothers with their babies (about 3 months old at the time) You may even be able to get your picture with Lucy the Macaw

reviews.author: MELINDA HINES
reviews.text: This was the most fun part of our trip. Loved seeing the dolphins be active and so many of them, too. Thank you so much. We absolutely loved the cruise!

reviews.author: Lucille Lockhart
reviews.text: Our Dolphin cruise on Sunny Lady was awesome, had a beautiful day. The day of our cruise was our anniversary (11/15). Had a great time. Crew was professional, fun time. Will book again.

reviews.author: Terri Zimmerman
reviews.text: Easy, Simple, transaction. Thank you. Will use you again in the future.

meeting_point: 4673 Wharf Parkway West, Orange Beach AL
highlights: Enjoy a scenic dolphin cruise & joy ride aboard the Sunny Lady in Orange Beach, Alabama
Boat is fully-equipped with open decks, climate-controlled cabins, & snack bar
Explores the intercoastal waterway where dolphins are plentiful
See dolphins & other marine wildlife up close
Great activity for the whole family
restrictions: Minimum of 20 paying passengers to depart.
Passengers ages 7 and under must wear life vests at all times.
Large parties (over 15) must reserve at least 24 hours prior.
Mobility scooters not permitted; power wheelchairs allowed.
Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
Must be 21+ to consume alcoholic beverages.
No smoking, vapes, cigars, or pipes.
